n8d9c29ea9a.headline: ICO banned in China
n8d9c29ea9a.summary: The People's Bank of China declared ICOs banned and ordered immediate suspension of all related activities due to financial violations.
n8d9c29ea9a.why: China is a major player in the global cryptocurrency market; its regulatory stance significantly affects crypto trading, innovation, and investor sentiment worldwide.
n8d9c29ea9a.why_moved: China's ban on ICOs caused a sharp contraction in crypto market activity and increased regulatory uncertainty globally.

n6f3832a836.headline: How much 'Ukrposhta' will save thanks to the gas supply license — Delo.ua
n6f3832a836.summary: Ukrposhta will save 20-25% on purchasing 3.5 million cubic meters of natural gas after obtaining a license to supply gas in Ukraine.
n6f3832a836.why: Ukrposhta is Ukraine's national postal operator; reducing energy costs improves its operational efficiency and financial health.
